datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data across Zimbabwe on a monthly basis (January, April, July, October 2015). The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative units and stored in geographic formats (GeoJSON, KML) to represent the geographic distribution of acute food insecurity phases across the country.
